note: Every engine FrameMotion can render. Own engines have a page (relative to this folder) that sets window.__framemotion. Bundled engines have a build (a builder in kit/builders.mjs makes their page in a temporary folder) and adapter renderFrame. sources name entries of integrations/sources.json; blocks are modules other engines may import. params declares each engine setting (type, default, min, max); width and height are always allowed and the renderer refuses anything else. optional lists files a page may ask for that are allowed to be missing (a film's music in a silent render); any other missing file fails the render. A param marked timing changes the engine's duration or frame rate, so the renderer then takes those from the page instead of the registry. group, about, good_for and inputs feed the welcome menu (scripts/engine_menu.py) and the per-scene engine choice: group names one of groups, about is one plain sentence for the user, good_for and inputs name what the engine is good for and what it takes. method_of names the engine an entry is a second way of animating (the same look by another method, Kamil 2026-11-20: duplicates improve an engine, never a second one); the menu lists it under that engine, not on its own.
